intro.fallback: Confused and frightened, the group leaps from the open window of the tower when Jotaro feels the bloodlust of DIO begin to creep up on him, utilizing their Stands to land safely on the lower roofs of the mansion.

Just then the sunset becomes imminent, and although Joseph reasons that they must go on the defensive to survive the inevitable onslaught DIO will bring now that the situation is in his favor, Polnareff refuses to run…
